Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine results indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, nitrites, and leukocyte esterase positivity. The presence of glucose in urine is abnormal and may warrant further evaluation for glycosuria/diabetes. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
